title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Judges 11: Jephthah the Gileadite is driven out by his brothers and called back to fight Ammon, then sends a message to the king and makes his vow.

questions.text: Besides being a mighty man of valor, what does the text say about Jephthah's mother?
questions.explanation: Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor, and he was the son of a prostitute.

questions.text: Where did Jephthah live after he fled from his brothers?
questions.explanation: Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob, where outlaws joined up with him.

questions.text: Who went to get Jephthah when Ammon made war against Israel?
questions.explanation: When the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob.

questions.text: What reason did the king of Ammon give for fighting against Israel?
questions.explanation: He said Israel took away his land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan.

answers.text: Jephthah had killed the king's own son
Israel refused to pay him tribute
Israel had taken his land when coming up out of Egypt
Gilead had broken a treaty with him

questions.text: Which king of the Amorites refused to let Israel pass and fought against them at Jahaz?
questions.explanation: Sihon king of the Amorites didn't trust Israel to pass through his border, gathered his people, encamped in Jahaz and fought against Israel.

questions.text: Which god did Jephthah name as the one who gives the king of Ammon land to possess?
questions.explanation: Jephthah asked, "Won't you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess?"

questions.text: What did Jephthah vow to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: He vowed that whatever came out of the doors of his house to meet him when he returned in peace would be Yahweh's, and he would offer it up as a burnt offering.

answers.text: To build an altar to Yahweh at Mizpah in Gilead
To give a tenth of the plunder to the priests
To never cut his hair as long as he lived
To offer up as a burnt offering whatever came out to meet him

questions.text: How did Jephthah's daughter come out to meet him?
questions.explanation: His daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances; she was his only child.

questions.text: How long did Jephthah's daughter ask to go to the mountains with her companions?
questions.explanation: She said, "Leave me alone two months," and he sent her away for two months.

questions.text: For how many days a year did the daughters of Israel go to celebrate Jephthah's daughter?
questions.explanation: It became a custom that the daughters of Israel went yearly to celebrate the daughter of Jephthah four days in a year.
